lines: This town is known as the grave site of Pokémon.
Memorial services are held in Pokémon Tower.
Ghosts appeared in Pokémon Tower.
I think they're the spirits of Pokémon that the Rockets killed.
I hate those horrible Rockets!
That poor Cubone's mother...
It was killed trying to escape from Team Rocket!
Cubones wear skulls, right?
People will pay a lot for one!
Did you come to pay respects?
Bless your Pokémon-loving heart.
Pokémon Tower was erected in the memory of Pokémon that died.
I came to pray for my Clefairy.
Sniff! I can't stop crying...
I am a Channeler.
There are spirits up to mischief.
I sense them high in the Tower.

battle: May the departed souls of Pokémon rest in peace...
What do you want? Why are you here?
I'm not going to forget this!

lines: This old guy came and complained about us harming useless Pokémon!
battle: We're talking it over as adults!
Pokémon are only good for making money! Stay out of our business!

lines: Hey! What brings you here? Is your Pokémon dead?
Hey! It's alive!
battle: I can at least make them faint! Let's go!
What? You stinker! I took it easy on you too!
Well, I better get going. I've got a lot to accomplish, unlike you. Smell ya later!

lines: Heh? You came to save me?
Thank you. But, I came here of my own free will.
I came to calm the spirit of Cubone's mother.
I think Marowak's spirit has finally left us.
